item.title: Typer Util 1.0.1
item.description: - **One license, all your Macs.** Your license key now works on as many Macs as you like, with no limit and nothing to deactivate when you switch to a new one. - Opening Preferences closes the typing window, so it no longer floats over Preferences.

item.title: Typer Util 1.0.0
item.description:
**Typer Util 1.0** types text into apps and web forms that block pasting or mangle pasted text.
- Press **⇧⌘K** anywhere, enter your text, press **Ready** (⌘⏎), then click into the field. Typer Util types it once the countdown ends. - **Slow, Normal and Fast** speeds (⌘1–⌘3), or set the exact time between keystrokes. - **Warnings before surprises**: new lines and tabs (which press Return and Tab, and can submit forms), and characters that aren't on your keyboard layout. Each has an option to avoid it. - **Works from anywhere**: the Services menu, a `typerutil://` URL scheme, AppleScript, and a `typerutil` command for Terminal. - **Free for 7 days**, then one license covers up to 5 Macs. - **Automatic updates**, signed and notarized by Apple.
